steps.title: Launch isolated native session
preconditions: SCRIV_E2E_APP names a matching actual Catalyst automation bundle on macOS; no fallback driver. ScrivSession.launch includes its own capabilities handshake and owned-root verification.
actions: ScrivSession.launch(process.env.SCRIV_E2E_APP) [public launch includes capabilities handshake; fresh synthetic root]

expectations.description: The real session returns a verified synthetic root after its launch handshake.

steps.title: Save isolated startup
preconditions: One fresh real automation-enabled Catalyst ScrivSession, synthetic root only; no live user project and no cloud account. Native execution remains NOT RUN until an actual matching macOS bundle executes the journey.

This is the ordered public session-method call plan, not a fixed wire transcript. Each waitFor expands to 1..N snapshot reads with 50 ms delays and a 15000 ms deadline. waitForSavedProject expands to 1..N persisted-projects reads with 75 ms delays, retrying only the exact publication-pending error. Callback command timeouts can extend wall time; writes are never retried.

Dynamic targets are fresh snapshot paths. tabs is the unique enabled/hittable workspace-tabs; queryField is the unique focused Find field; named button targets are unique enabled/hittable mounted controls. No conditional scrolling, model setters or unlisted setup commands occur.

UUIDs and Date values are observed from prior import results, not fixed inputs. exported.text is the prior actual export, required by assertions to equal the literal expectedExport. aliasInput is a JSON input copy of the original import with title=Midnight aliases, Mara aliases=[Nightwatch], revision=17, createdAt=1600000000000 and modifiedAt=1600000001000; import must reset revision to0 and both dates to the same new millisecond inside the observed import call window (±1ms rounding).
On failure the entrypoint closes the one process in finally and later phases do not run. The normal-success sequence includes launch and final close. No test execution is inferred from this catalog.

tItLe:
    Midnight Ledger
    Return
Author: Test Writer

[[scriv duration=123 coverage=456]]

@MARA (V.O.)
(quietly)
We wait.

[[scriv duration=0 coverage=7]]

@mara (CONT'D)
Return now.

[[scriv duration=1800 coverage=0]]

.An empty interlude

expectations.description: Exactly one fresh saved project appears, all earlier packages are unchanged, loaded content equals saved content, and the independently specified document oracle matches.

The imported document matches its exact literal expectedDocument/boundaryDocument oracle: title, ordered scene titles, entry order/text/kind/speaker/duration/coverage, exact word timing, characters and cues; generated identities are unique. See the selected fixture variant in the action.

mappings.why: Scene-heading detection supports recognized INT. headings and forced custom scene export/import; not all recognized heading variants.

Opening BOM/CRLF multiline mixed-case title and known/unknown metadata are consumed by the opening title-page parser; unknown opening Warning remains source in the separate plain-text fixture. Known metadata-looking keys later in body text and every invalid-key branch are not separately claimed.
BOM removal, newline normalization, implicit initial scene, buffered entry creation and estimated direction timings match exact saved payloads.

The leading annotation with no entry is ignored; literal forced-action annotations stay text; later valid timing annotations apply and negative, noninteger and over-limit fields are ignored. Two dialogue words clamp duration zero to two milliseconds.
Forced paragraphs preserve scene-looking/@/annotation continuation text; ordinary and custom headings keep an explicit empty middle scene without an extra initial scene.
Explicit Mara speaker markers and V.O./CONT'D suffixes resolve to one catalog identity; no claim for physical input or every uppercase-name heuristic variant.

Case-insensitive reuse, parenthetical forward direction, following dialogue, final flush and positive-duration-only scene cues produce the literal full document oracle. Alias lookup inside Fountain and the empty-name guard are not separately claimed.
Accepted bounded UTF-8 input reaches Fountain parsing, normal validation and installation; malformed UTF-8, size rejection and error presentation remain excluded.
